```{r, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(splines)
library(mgcv)
library(knitr)

save_plot <- function(p, name, width = 7, height = 4.5) {
  ggsave(filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot = p,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in")
  ggsave(filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot = p,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  invisible(p)
}

save_table <- function(x, name, digits = 3, align = NULL) {
  tex <- knitr::kable(x, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
                      digits = digits, align = align)
  writeLines(tex, file.path(tbl_dir, paste0(name, ".tex")))
  invisible(x)
}

rmse <- function(y, yhat) sqrt(mean((y - yhat)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae <- function(y, yhat) mean(abs(y - yhat), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq <- function(y, yhat) {
  ok <- is.finite(yhat)
  y <- y[ok]
  yhat <- yhat[ok]
  1 - sum((y - yhat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
}
logloss <- function(y, p) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  -mean(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p))
}
brier <- function(y, p) mean((y - p)^2)
accuracy <- function(y, p, threshold = 0.5) mean((p >= threshold) == (y == 1))

# Helper: Basic RMSE calculation
rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Helper: Generate fold assignments
cv_assignments <- function(n, K = 10, seed = 5703) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
}

# Generalized LOESS prediction with boundary interpolation
predict_loess_safe <- function(model, newdata, x_col, train_x = NULL) {
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata)
  if (all(!is.na(pred))) return(as.numeric(pred))
  
  if (is.null(train_x)) stop("train_x must be supplied when loess predictions contain NA values.")
  
  # Create data frame with correct column name for training fit
  train_df <- data.frame(train_x)
  colnames(train_df) <- x_col
  fitted_train <- predict(model, newdata = train_df)
  
  # Linear interpolation for out-of-bounds x values (rule = 2)
  approx(x = train_x, y = fitted_train, xout = newdata[[x_col]], rule = 2)$y
}

# Generalized Step Model creation
make_step_model <- function(train_data, x_col, y_col, bins) {
  x_vals <- train_data[[x_col]]
  
  # Create breaks based on local data range
  br <- seq(min(x_vals), max(x_vals), length.out = bins + 1)
  br[1] <- br[1] - 1e-6
  br[length(br)] <- br[length(br)] + 1e-6
  
  # Temporary column for fitting
  train_data$tmp_bin <- cut(x_vals, breaks = br, include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  form <- reformulate("tmp_bin", response = y_col)
  fit  <- lm(form, data = train_data)
  
  # Store metadata for prediction
  list(fit = fit, breaks = br, x_col = x_col)
}

# Generalized Step Model prediction
predict_step_model <- function(obj, newdata) {
  # Apply the same breaks to the new data
  newdata$tmp_bin <- cut(newdata[[obj$x_col]], breaks = obj$breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  predict(obj$fit, newdata = newdata)
}

# Main K-Fold Cross Validation Function
kfold_rmse <- function(model_type, values, data, y_col, x_col, K = 10) {
  folds <- cv_assignments(nrow(data), K = K, seed = 5703)
  out <- data.frame(setting = values, cv_rmse = NA_real_)

  for (i in seq_along(values)) {
    val <- values[i]
    fold_err <- numeric(K)

    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      train <- data[folds != k, ]
      valid <- data[folds == k, ]
      y_true <- valid[[y_col]]

      if (model_type == "poly") {
        form <- reformulate(sprintf("poly(%s, %d)", x_col, val), response = y_col)
        fit  <- lm(form, data = train)
        pred <- predict(fit, newdata = valid)
        
      } else if (model_type == "step") {
        fit  <- make_step_model(train, x_col = x_col, y_col = y_col, bins = val)
        pred <- predict_step_model(fit, valid)
        
      } else if (model_type == "ns") {
        # Requires the 'splines' library
        form <- reformulate(sprintf("splines::ns(%s, df = %d)", x_col, val), response = y_col)
        fit  <- lm(form, data = train)
        pred <- predict(fit, newdata = valid)
        
      } else if (model_type == "ss") {
        fit  <- smooth.spline(train[[x_col]], train[[y_col]], df = val)
        pred <- predict(fit, x = valid[[x_col]])$y
        
      } else if (model_type == "loess") {
        form <- reformulate(x_col, response = y_col)
        fit  <- loess(form, data = train, span = val, degree = 1)
        pred <- predict_loess_safe(fit, newdata = valid, x_col = x_col, train_x = train[[x_col]])
        
      } else {
        stop("Unknown model_type")
      }

      fold_err[k] <- rmse(y_true, pred)
    }
    out$cv_rmse[i] <- mean(fold_err)
  }
  out
}

```


# Problem 2

```{r}
set.seed(5703)

sim_fun <- function(n) {
  x1 <- runif(n, 18, 70)
  x2 <- runif(n, 0, 1)
  x3 <- rnorm(n)
  x4 <- rnorm(n)
  z <- factor(sample(c("A", "B", "C"), n, replace = TRUE,
                prob = c(0.40, 0.35, 0.25)))
  
  mu <- 75 + 1.6 * x1 - 0.018 * x1^2 +
          10 * sin(2 * pi * x2) + 4 * x3 +
          6 * (z == "B") - 8 * (z == "C")
  
  y <- mu + rnorm(n, sd = 12)
  
  eta <- -6 + 0.11 * x1 - 0.0012 * x1^2 +
  1.4 * sin(2 * pi * x2) + 0.7 * x3 +
  0.9 * (z == "B") - 0.7 * (z == "C")
  
  p <- plogis(eta)
  y_bin <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p)
  data.frame(x1, x2, x3, x4, z, mu, p, y, y_bin)
}

train <- sim_fun(400)
test <- sim_fun(2000)
```

```{r}
linear <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + z, data=train)
polynomial <- lm(y ~ poly(x1, 2) + poly(x2, 2) + x3 + x4 + z, data=train)
nat_spline <- lm(y ~ ns(x1, df = 3) + ns(x2, df = 4) + x3 + x4 + z, data = train)
gam <- gam(y ~ s(x1) + s(x2) + x3 + x4 + z, data = train)

multivariable_compare <- data.frame(
  model = c("Linear age + year + education",
            "Polynomial age + year + education",
            "Natural splines for age and year",
            "GAM with smooth age and year"),
  aic = c(AIC(linear), AIC(polynomial), AIC(nat_spline), AIC(gam)),
  test_rmse = c(
    rmse(test$y, predict(linear, newdata = test)),
    rmse(test$y, predict(polynomial, newdata = test)),
    rmse(test$y, predict(nat_spline, newdata = test)),
    rmse(test$y, predict(gam, newdata = test))
  ),
  test_mae = c(
    mae(test$y, predict(linear, newdata = test)),
    mae(test$y, predict(polynomial, newdata = test)),
    mae(test$y, predict(nat_spline, newdata = test)),
    mae(test$y, predict(gam, newdata = test))
  ),
  test_r2 = c(
    rsq(test$y, predict(linear, newdata = test)),
    rsq(test$y, predict(polynomial, newdata = test)),
    rsq(test$y, predict(nat_spline, newdata = test)),
    rsq(test$y, predict(gam, newdata = test))
  )
)
save_table(multivariable_compare, "tbl_multivariable_model_compare", digits = 3)
kable(multivariable_compare, digits = 3)
```
